name: BMW R nineT
engine: 1170 cc air/oil-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: BMW's retro boxer. Early bikes had a swingarm pivot bolt recall. Grease the drive splines.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014-2017 bikes are in recall 17V502 (swingarm pivot pin bolts may loosen). Some 2018-2020 bikes are in recall 20V166 (brake fluid reservoir cap).

add.title: Lube the drive splines
add.instructions: Pull the rear drive and clean and grease the shaft splines with a moly paste. Look for oil in the swingarm.
add.reason: Dry splines wear and fail. Most owners forget to grease them.

recalls.what: Right-side swingarm pivot pin bolts may loosen.
recalls.fix: Dealer cleans and refits the bolts free.
